title: MountainCarContinuous reinforcement learning experiment
goal: Train a continuous-action reinforcement learning agent on the MountainCarContinuous-v0 environment to maximize cumulative reward.
requirements: design 2-4 materially different RL approaches (e.g. DDPG, SAC, PPO, or custom)
train on MountainCarContinuous-v0 using GPU acceleration
select best policy by highest cumulative reward
